12.t: Working with data: testing a hypothesis
q: At which temperature did the bears grow most?
How much more did the bear grow at 35 degrees C than at 5 degrees C?
Do the results support the hypothesis? Use numbers in your answer.
Yes: growth increased from 0.6 cm at 5 degrees C to 1.0 cm at 20 degrees C and 1.5 cm at 35 degrees C, so warmer water gave more growth.
Only one bear was used at each temperature. Explain why the conclusion may not be reliable and how to improve it.

One bear could be unusual (a different size or brand), so the result may not repeat. Use three or more bears at each temperature, calculate a mean, and test more temperatures to see the pattern clearly.
